about_the_game:
Will you be able to find success in this divine mission? You and Mo, your moai pal , must reach the top of the Moai World before seven days pass to prevent its destruction.

If you fail, the world will reset, and you’ll have to start from the very beginning.

So run, jump, and reach higher and higher places alongside Mo—but be careful! A single wrong move could send you tumbling into the darkest depths of despair.

In this world you will take the body of a pair of shoes that never stop running, forcing you to jump and move forward throughout the entire game.

With Mo, your moai friend, you can charge energy, launch him, and propel yourself towards him. Mastering the charge , the timing of when to launch, and when to dash toward him is a skill only a few will achieve—but it’s essential to complete your mission.

Every fall, every mistake, must be a lesson that makes you stronger.

Discover the vast Moai world , from its deep sewers to the white tower in top of the world, passing through unique environments.

So take on this challenge and embark on this epic adventure!

short_description: Get ready for an impossible quest! You and Mo, your Moai pal, must reach the Moai World’s summit. Keep running, jumping, and climbing—but beware! One mistake can sends you plummeting into the darkest depths of despair. Reach the top before the seventh day or the world resets. Learn, Adapt and Rise.
